source.title: Nebraska DHHS Division of Public Health Laboratory Certification — certified labs PDF + Public Health Environmental Laboratory private-citizen kit path (Customer Service / Private Citizen Water Test Kit Request Form) + DWEE private-well sampling guidance
limitations: Primary roster: Nebraska DHHS “certified labs.pdf” linked from Lab Certification Requirements “Certified Labs” action item; retrieved 19 September 2026. PDF metadata ModDate Wed May 22, 2024 — no newer downloadable statewide drinking-water certified-lab PDF found tonight; verify current status with Lab Certification Manager (402-471-8407) before shipping.
PDF prints Name of Lab, Certification #, Address, and Certified for Analytes — it does not print commercial phone numbers. Phone marked unknown for all commercial rows.
Central District Health Department (NE-04-01; Grand Island) omitted from commercial table as a local health department laboratory.
Metropolitan Utilities Districts (NE-04-04; Omaha) omitted from commercial table as a municipal / utility laboratory.
Commercial private-well acceptance unknown for every commercial row — call first.

Verified private-well path is Nebraska Public Health Environmental Laboratory (NPHEL) private-citizen kits (bacteria / coliform and nitrate) via Private Citizen Water Test Kit Request Form or Customer Service 402-471-3935; NPHEL kits required; form states samples over 30 hours old will not be tested; mail/deliver Monday–Thursday; fees appear on DWEE article and Customer Service pages but are intentionally omitted from public HTML.
UNL Water Drinking Water Testing page linked only as Extension guidance; NebGuide G1614 points to DHHS certified list — not used as the certified roster.
Arkansas (request-only ADH DW list) and Kansas (JS AB Manager database without a verified downloadable export tonight) skipped in favor of Nebraska’s official PDF.

verified_paths.name: Nebraska Public Health Environmental Laboratory — private citizen bacteria / coliform kits
verified_paths.notes: Private Citizen Water Test Kit Request Form offers Type of Bacteria Kit (Presence/Absence or Numerical Count) and Nitrate kits. Form states: lab has a 90-day return policy on kits; Coliform samples must be collected and mailed the same day; deliver or mail Monday through Thursday; beware of state and federal holidays; Sample over 30 hours old will not be tested. Customer Service page (Lab-Price-List): order kits online (Private Clients or Companies) or call NPHEL Customer Service at 402-471-3935, Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. except holidays; samples must be collected in NPHEL-supplied kits; instructions included. Public Health Lab hub: Main laboratory 402-471-2122; sample kits press 2 (471-3935); private well results interpretation press 3 (471-4982); mailing address 3701 South 14th St., Lincoln, Nebraska 68502. Fees intentionally omitted — confirm with NPHEL.

verified_paths.name: Nebraska DWEE — sample private drinking water wells (kit path guidance)
verified_paths.notes: DWEE states well owners can request sample kits from Nebraska DHHS online; lab tests for presence of coliform bacteria; nitrate guidance included (do not boil high-nitrate water). Article links DHHS kit ordering and NPHEL price list. Used as corroborating private-well guidance pointing to the same NPHEL kits — not as a certified roster.
